    • getDisplayName

      String getDisplayName()
      Gets the "friendly" name to display of this player. This may include color. 获取该玩家用于显示的“友好”名称。其中可以包含颜色。

      Note that this name will not be displayed in game, only in chat and places defined by plugins. 注意，此名称不会在游戏中显示，只会在聊天和插件定义的位置中显示。

      返回:
      the friendly name 友好名称

    • setDisplayName

      void setDisplayName(String name)
      Sets the "friendly" name to display of this player. This may include color. 设置该玩家用于显示的“友好”名称。其中可以包含颜色。

      Note that this name will not be displayed in game, only in chat and places defined by plugins. 注意，此名称不会在游戏中显示，只会在聊天和插件定义的位置中显示。

      参数:
      name - The new display name. 新的显示名称。

    • getPlayerListName

    • setPlayerListName

      void setPlayerListName(String name)
      Sets the name that is shown on the in-game player list. 设置游戏内玩家列表中显示的名称。

      The name cannot be longer than 16 characters, but ChatColor is supported. 名称不能超过 16 个字符，但支持 ChatColor。

      If the value is null, the name will be identical to HumanEntity.getName(). 若该值为 null，名称将与 HumanEntity.getName() 相同。

      This name is case sensitive and unique, two names with different casing will appear as two different people. If a player joins afterwards with a name that conflicts with a player's custom list name, the joining player's player list name will have a random number appended to it (1-2 characters long in the default implementation). If the joining player's name is 15 or 16 characters long, part of the name will be truncated at the end to allow the addition of the two digits. 此名称区分大小写且唯一，大小写不同的两个名称会显示为两个不同的人。如果之后加入的玩家与某玩家的自定义列表名称冲突，加入玩家的玩家列表名称末尾将附加一个随机数字（默认实现中为 1-2 个字符长）。如果加入玩家的名称长 15 或 16 个字符，名称末尾将被截断一部分，以便添加这两位数字。

      参数:
      name - new player list name 新的玩家列表名称
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is already used by someone 若该名称已被他人使用 else
      IllegalArgumentException - if the length of the name is too long 若名称长度过长

      This name is case-sensitive and unique, two names with different casing will appear as two different people. If a player joins afterward with a name that conflicts with a player's custom list name, the joining player's player list name will have a random number appended to it (1-2 characters long in the default implementation). If the joining player's name is 15 or 16 characters long, part of the name will be truncated at the end to allow the addition of the two digits. 此名称区分大小写且唯一，大小写不同的两个名称会显示为两个不同的人。如果之后加入的玩家与某玩家的自定义列表名称冲突，加入玩家的玩家列表名称末尾将附加一个随机数字（默认实现中为 1-2 个字符长）。如果加入玩家的名称长 15 或 16 个字符，名称末尾将被截断一部分，以便添加这两位数字。

      参数:
      playerListName - new player list name 新的玩家列表名称
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is already used by someone 若该名称已被他人使用 else
      IllegalArgumentException - if the length of the name is too long 若名称长度过长

    • setPlayerTime

      void setPlayerTime(long time, boolean relative)
      Sets the current time on the player's client. When relative is true the player's time will be kept synchronized to its world time with the specified offset. 设置该玩家客户端的当前时间。当 relative 为 true 时，玩家时间将按指定偏移量与其世界时间保持同步。

      When using non relative time the player's time will stay fixed at the specified time parameter. It's up to the caller to continue updating the player's time. To restore player time to normal use resetPlayerTime(). 使用非相对时间时，玩家时间将固定在指定的时间参数上。由调用者负责持续更新玩家时间。要将玩家时间恢复正常，请使用 resetPlayerTime()。

      参数:
      time - The current player's perceived time or the player's time 该玩家感知到的当前时间，或玩家时间相对服务器时间的偏移量。 offset from the server time.
      relative - When true the player time is kept relative to its world 为 true 时玩家时间保持与其世界时间相对。 time.

    • setTexturePack

      @Deprecated void setTexturePack(String url)
      已过时。
      Minecraft no longer uses textures packs. Instead you Minecraft 不再使用材质包（texture pack）。请改用 setResourcePack(String)。 should use setResourcePack(String).
      Request that the player's client download and switch texture packs. 请求该玩家的客户端下载并切换材质包（texture pack）。

      The player's client will download the new texture pack asynchronously in the background, and will automatically switch to it once the download is complete. If the client has downloaded and cached the same texture pack in the past, it will perform a quick timestamp check over the network to determine if the texture pack has changed and needs to be downloaded again. When this request is sent for the very first time from a given server, the client will first display a confirmation GUI to the player before proceeding with the download. 玩家的客户端将在后台异步下载新的材质包，下载完成后自动切换。如果客户端过去已下载并缓存了同一材质包，它将通过网络进行一次快速的时间戳检查，以确定该材质包是否已更改而需要重新下载。当某个服务器第一次发送此请求时，客户端会先向玩家显示确认界面，然后再开始下载。

      Notes: 注意：

      • Players can disable server textures on their client, in which case this method will have no affect on them. 玩家可以在其客户端上禁用服务器材质，此时此方法对他们无效。
      • There is no concept of resetting texture packs back to default within Minecraft, so players will have to relog to do so. Minecraft 中没有将材质包重置回默认的概念，因此玩家必须重新登录才能做到。
      参数:
      url - The URL from which the client will download the texture 客户端从中下载材质包的 URL。该字符串只能包含 US-ASCII 字符，且应按照 RFC 1738 编码。 pack. The string must contain only US-ASCII characters and should be encoded as per RFC 1738.
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the URL is null. 若 URL 为 null。
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the URL is too long. 若 URL 过长。

    • setResourcePack

      void setResourcePack(String url)
      Request that the player's client download and switch resource packs. 请求该玩家的客户端下载并切换资源包。

      The player's client will download the new resource pack asynchronously in the background, and will automatically switch to it once the download is complete. If the client has downloaded and cached the same resource pack in the past, it will perform a quick timestamp check over the network to determine if the resource pack has changed and needs to be downloaded again. When this request is sent for the very first time from a given server, the client will first display a confirmation GUI to the player before proceeding with the download. 玩家的客户端将在后台异步下载新的资源包，下载完成后自动切换。如果客户端过去已下载并缓存了同一资源包，它将通过网络进行一次快速的时间戳检查，以确定该资源包是否已更改而需要重新下载。当某个服务器第一次发送此请求时，客户端会先向玩家显示确认界面，然后再开始下载。

      Notes: 注意：

      • Players can disable server resources on their client, in which case this method will have no affect on them. 玩家可以在其客户端上禁用服务器资源，此时此方法对他们无效。
      • There is no concept of resetting resource packs back to default within Minecraft, so players will have to relog to do so. Minecraft 中没有将资源包重置回默认的概念，因此玩家必须重新登录才能做到。
      参数:
      url - The URL from which the client will download the resource 客户端从中下载资源包的 URL。该字符串只能包含 US-ASCII 字符，且应按照 RFC 1738 编码。 pack. The string must contain only US-ASCII characters and should be encoded as per RFC 1738.
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the URL is null. 若 URL 为 null。
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the URL is too long. The 若 URL 过长。长度限制是特定实现的任意值。 length restriction is an implementation specific arbitrary value.

      void setHealthScaled(boolean scale)
      Sets if the client is displayed a 'scaled' health, that is, health on a scale from 0-getHealthScale(). 设置客户端是否显示“缩放的”生命值，即在 0 到 getHealthScale() 之间的标度上显示的生命值。

      Displayed health follows a simple formula displayedHealth = getHealth() / getMaxHealth() * getHealthScale(). 显示的生命值遵循简单的公式 displayedHealth = getHealth() / getMaxHealth() * getHealthScale()。
